bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VGBP is natively issued on Base, Celo, and Solana. The pinned August 16, 2026 reviews below identified chain-local VNXCToken and SPL mint authorities without on-chain bridge machinery. Current VNX Global documentation describes a separate issuer-operated burn-and-mint transfer service under its signing quorum, with no wrapped representation. That operational rail does not establish an external message-validation network, a new token contract, or freshly verified controller permissions; the existing native route observations remain dated August 16, 2026.

The three authored native routes retain their original August 16 observations. It grants no renewed controller, signing-quorum, cap, reconciliation or incident claim.
